name: TMK
recent: TMK Chemical 于 2026 年 9 月 18 日签署有条件买卖协议，拟以 RM939.9 million 收购 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 100% 股权，其中约 RM438.5 million 以现金支付，其余通过发行 262,500,000 股新股支付。此外，公司于 8 月宣布每股 3.6 sen 的中期股息，除权日为 10 月 7 日。
notable: 拟以 RM939.9 million 收购 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad 100% 股权，其中约 RM438.5 million 以现金支付，其余通过发行 262,500,000 股新股支付。
宣布每股 3.6 sen 的中期单层股息，除权日 2026 年 10 月 7 日，派发日 2026 年 11 月 4 日。
risks: 收购代价包含发行 262,500,000 股新股，占现有股本一定比例，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
Batu Kawan Berhad 及其一致行动人寻求豁免强制全面收购义务，需获得 Securities Commission Malaysia 批准。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM310.4 million，环比增长 28.6%，同比增长 17.7%；净利为 RM40.8 million，环比增长 35.4%，同比增长 91.5%；净利率为 13.1%，高于上一季度的 12.5%。

recent_en: On 18 September 2026, TMK Chemical signed a conditional share sale and purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) for RM939.9 million, satisfied via approximately RM438.5 million in cash and the issuance of 262,500,000 new shares. The company is also seeking an exemption for Batu Kawan Berhad and its concert parties from the mandatory general offer obligation arising from the acquisition. Separately, the company declared an interim dividend of 3.6 sen per share in August, with an ex-date of 7 October.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad for RM939.9 million, satisfied via approximately RM438.5 million in cash and the issuance of 262,500,000 new shares.
Proposed exemption for Batu Kawan Berhad and its concert parties from the mandatory general offer obligation arising from the acquisition.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 3.6 sen per share, with ex-date on 7 October 2026 and payment date on 4 November 2026.
risks_en: The acquisition consideration includes the issuance of 262,500,000 new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
Batu Kawan Berhad and its concert parties are seeking an exemption from the mandatory general offer obligation, subject to approval from the Securities Commission Malaysia.
earnings_en: For the second quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM310.4 million, up 28.6% QoQ and 17.7% YoY; net income was RM40.8 million, up 35.4% QoQ and 91.5% YoY; net margin was 13.1%, higher than 12.5% in the previous quarter.
